retroactive_metric.definition: reaction_latency = first assistant record after the queued_command minus the notice; idle_gap = silence between the last and next assistant/user record around the notice; records ordered by timestamp, not file position

decisions: stop_hook_active: honoured through a persisted per-agent refusal counter. With the flag set and no previous refusal on record the guard passes (loop not started by this guard); with a record the budget max_stop_refusals still applies, so max_stop_refusals=2 is reachable. Alternative (flag always passes) would make the budget 1.
A plain Stop with no agent_id/teammate_name/agent_type is the interactive session waiting for its user and passes untouched
Refusal mechanism: Stop/SubagentStop emit {decision:block,reason}; TeammateIdle exits 2 with stderr guidance
Reports go through `hseos liveness report` (LV2). Until it exists the event is parked in .hseos/state/liveness/pending-reports.jsonl with a stderr warning
Wake requests are injected once and moved to inbox/delivered/; the LV2 watchdog owns retries via attempt+1
Metric script is .mjs because eslint applies ESM rules to docs/

correction_round_1.config_snapshot: config.last-valid.json is refreshed on every valid parse, including enabled:false (never created while disabled and absent); an invalid file always warns; a removed contract file ignores the snapshot. correction_round_1.background_status: active = running|pending|queued; known terminal statuses (completed, succeeded, success, error, timeout, killed, cancelled, aborted, ...) are inactive; unknown or missing status warns on stderr and never refuses.
